calculation.description: Ranks assets for 10-day reversal using negative 20-day return, amplified by position in the trailing 60-day range and normalized by trailing 20-day realized volatility. Higher values indicate more exhausted downside relative to risk and range location.

validation.regime_notes: 878 valid cross-sectional dates, 15 instruments, average 14.98 valid instruments. Regime means reported by the executed script: 2025 +0.154019 over 109 dates; 2027-2028 -0.008030 over 521 dates; 2029 +0.054276 over 248 dates. Results are promising but regime dependent; conservative sizing is appropriate.
